label: Straight Welt 2.3 cm
description: A straight welt breast pocket at 2.3 cm is the narrowest conventional English welt, lending the chest a particularly refined, restrained line. The slim welt draws minimal attention to itself and reads as deliberate minimalism rather than economy, suiting dark worsted city suits and formal jackets. The opening is left completely empty so the full length of the welt and the precision of its finishing at each end are visible end to end. This width is especially popular with Savile Row firms who favour a long, lean chest line, the welt standing proud of the chest as a single narrow band with its top and bottom edges running parallel.

garment.fabric: fine wool suiting with visible weave
